async def act(page):
    # Click 'Add Attribute' button to open the dialog for adding attributes.
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Add Attribute').click()
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
    
    # Use the 'Filters' button to search for 'color'.
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Filters').click()
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    # Fill in the filter field for 'Attribute Code' or 'Attribute Label'.
    filter_field = page.get_by_role('textbox').first
    await filter_field.fill('color')
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    # Look for the 'color' row and select it.
    color_row = page.get_by_role('row').filter(has_text='color')
    if await color_row.count() > 0:
        await color_row.get_by_role('checkbox').check()
    # Clear the filter and search for 'size'.
    await filter_field.fill('')
    await filter_field.fill('size')
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    size_row = page.get_by_role('row').filter(has_text='size')
    if await size_row.count() > 0:
        await size_row.get_by_role('checkbox').check()
    # Click 'Add Selected' to add both attributes to the product.
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Add Selected').click()
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
    # Close the dialog if it remains open.
    if await page.get_by_role('dialog', name='Add Attribute').count() > 0:
        await page.get_by_role('button', name='Cancel').first.click()
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    
    # Now, fill in the basic product details in the main form.
    await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='[STORE VIEW] Product Name *').fill('Lelelumon Yoga Mat')
    await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='[GLOBAL] SKU *').fill('LEL-YOGA-MAT')
    await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='[GLOBAL] Price * $').fill('769.99')
    await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='[GLOBAL] Quantity').fill('42')
    
    # Set the color attribute value to 'black'.
    # Look for a textbox or combobox with 'Color' in the main form.
    color_field = page.get_by_role('textbox').filter(has_text='Color')
    if await color_field.count() > 0:
        await color_field.fill('black')
    else:
        color_combobox = page.get_by_role('combobox').filter(has_text='Color')
        if await color_combobox.count() > 0:
            await color_combobox.select_option('black')
    
    # Set the size attribute value to 'uni-size'.
    size_field = page.get_by_role('textbox').filter(has_text='Size')
    if await size_field.count() > 0:
        await size_field.fill('uni-size')
    else:
        size_combobox = page.get_by_role('combobox').filter(has_text='Size')
        if await size_combobox.count() > 0:
            await size_combobox.select_option('uni-size')
    
    # Save the product.
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Save').click()
    await page.wait_for_timeout(5000)

async def act(page):
    # Click 'Add Attribute' button to open the dialog for adding attributes.
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Add Attribute').click()
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)

    # Use the 'Filters' button to search for 'color'.
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Filters').click()
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    # Fill in the filter field for 'Attribute Code' or 'Attribute Label'.
    filter_field = page.get_by_role('textbox').first
    await filter_field.fill('color')
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    # Look for the 'color' row and select it.
    color_row = page.get_by_role('row').filter(has_text='color')
    if await color_row.count() > 0:
        await color_row.get_by_role('checkbox').check()
    # Clear the filter and search for 'size'.
    await filter_field.fill('')
    await filter_field.fill('size')
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    size_row = page.get_by_role('row').filter(has_text='size')
    if await size_row.count() > 0:
        await size_row.get_by_role('checkbox').check()
    # Click 'Add Selected' to add both attributes to the product.
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Add Selected').click()
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
    # Close the dialog if it remains open.
    if await page.get_by_role('dialog', name='Add Attribute').count() > 0:
        await page.get_by_role('button', name='Cancel').first.click()
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)

    # Now, fill in the basic product details in the main form.
    await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='[STORE VIEW] Product Name *').fill('Lelelumon Yoga Mat')
    await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='[GLOBAL] SKU *').fill('LEL-YOGA-MAT')
    await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='[GLOBAL] Price * $').fill('769.99')
    await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='[GLOBAL] Quantity').fill('42')

    # Set the color attribute value to 'black'.
    # Look for a textbox or combobox with 'Color' in the main form.
    color_field = page.get_by_role('textbox').filter(has_text='Color')
    if await color_field.count() > 0:
        await color_field.fill('black')
    else:
        color_combobox = page.get_by_role('combobox').filter(has_text='Color')
        if await color_combobox.count() > 0:
            await color_combobox.select_option('black')

    # Set the size attribute value to 'uni-size'.
    size_field = page.get_by_role('textbox').filter(has_text='Size')
    if await size_field.count() > 0:
        await size_field.fill('uni-size')
    else:
        size_combobox = page.get_by_role('combobox').filter(has_text='Size')
        if await size_combobox.count() > 0:
            await size_combobox.select_option('uni-size')

    # Save the product.
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Save').click()
    await page.wait_for_timeout(5000)
